title: helictotrichon filifolium subsp. cazorlense
intro: Helictotrichon filifolium subsp. cazorlense, commonly known as Cazorla Needle Grass, is a rare and endangered species of grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Cazorla Needle Grass are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, that exhibit antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant activities. Research on this plant is ongoing, but preliminary findings suggest that it may have potential in the prevention and treatment of various diseases, including cardiovascular and neurodegenerative disorders.
